verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler has a dedicated Patent Counseling & Prosecution group page under its Intellectual Property practice. It says its patent attorneys identify valuable inventions and prepare and prosecute patent applications for clients from startups to Fortune 100s, which covers drafting and filing as a documented practice. The portfolio-strategy side (building a defensible patent position) is only implied by 'opinion and counseling work', and no individual practitioners are named. missing for 10: explicit portfolio strategy / defensible-position services, named patent practitioners or attorney bios, independent corroboration such as rankings or client matters.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Our patent attorneys help identify potentially valuable inventions, prepare and prosecute patent applications, and conduct related opinion and counseling work
